notes.title: Aozora Meikyuu 5th Anniversary
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11709262/365d92846bb4e0c5c1ed3bf8694ce01901141e1c.jpg[/img]

Today, 5 years ago my first Visual Novel Aozora Meikyuu was released on steam. To celebrate the anniversary Aozora Meikyuu will be 80% off for the next 24 h!
The artist from Aozora Meikyuu 5c also drew a new picture of Sora. 
Get it as 4k Wallpaper here: [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1x-tu_UZbu25UX9JeuedwXPKaPnVnRu-A/view?usp=sharing]Wallpaper Link[/url]

Thank you to everyone, who purchased Aozora Meikyuu in the past five years ^^
